bugs.what: Combat hit rates very low (needed 5+ on d20, missed twice with rolls of 4); feels tedious rather than challenging
Location transitions with Scout abilities (slipping past wight) are disorienting; player teleports to throne instead of smoothly continuing

confusions: Not clear that failing lock picks multiple times risks permanently breaking the lock; first attempt failure at strongbox prompted retry without warning
Barrow-wight fight felt optional but was unavoidable; unclear if there was a stealth-only path
The connection between 'heard yourself up in the barrow' and the elder opening the coffer required dialogue exploration; could be more explicit
suggestions: Increase base hit rates or add tactical combat options (dodge, parry) to make fights less tedious
Keep player at the location after using Scout abilities instead of teleporting elsewhere
Add explicit warning before risky lock picks: 'This old lock may break if you fail again'
Earlier hint that the king's speech at the throne counts as proof for the elder's coffer
